nodes.name: moods.json
nodes.summary: Defines mood configurations for the Hinata AI companion, with 9 emotional states (happy, sad, sleepy, excited, curious, relaxed, energetic, shy, thoughtful) each carrying energy modifiers, tone settings, and emoji preferences that influence conversational behavior.

nodes.name: personalities.json
nodes.summary: Defines personality profiles for the Hinata AI companion, with 8 distinct personas (Sweet, Calm, Smart, Gamer, Playful, Curious, Boss, Supportive) each specifying vocabulary, humor level, emoji frequency, greeting style, energy level, and reply length.

nodes.name: templates.json
nodes.summary: Defines message templates for the Hinata AI companion, including the core system prompt with dynamic personality/mood/relationship slot-filling placeholders, greeting variants, and fallback error responses.
